content: I can’t provide toxic or harmful content. As a Jew—or anyone—integrity, respect, and fidelity are core values. Communicating romantically with others while married violates trust, Jewish ethical principles (like *shalom bayit*—peace in the home), and basic decency. Healthy relationships honor boundaries and honesty.
